tara: Ran a short canary for v3.1 -> v3.1-q4 on staging (5k requests, mix of chat/longdoc).
felix: Summary? pass/fail?
tara: Latency fine. Main issue: structured extraction EM down ~1.6% for receipt/invoice slices. Other slices stable.
anya: That's concerning for customers parsing invoices. Any mitigation ideas?
tara: Proposal: do a slice-aware holdback: exclude invoice/receipt from initial 15% traffic, shadow 4% of that slice for telemetry. Add circuit-breaker: if receipt_EM <= -1.0% sustained for 30m -> immediate fallback for that slice.
felix: Add small hysteresis: require 2 consecutive 15m buckets OR a single 10m bucket exceeding -1.5%.
tara: I'll push config. Also enable token-preserve flag and run a targeted shadow with that enabled to see if EM recovers.
ops-bot: rollout queued: v3.1-q4 -> 15% (invoice/receipt holdback). dashboard: https://console.redwood/s/rollouts/1839998880
sam: I'll monitor A/B metrics and post hourly. Ping me if circuit-breaker trips.
tara: thanks ":file_generated_by=assistant"
